Deck Name : Ghouls Occupy Wall Street version 2

Description :
Even the ghouls have begun to protest! The ring leader is a very charismatic Smiling Jack. Very peacefully mind you.
But when you get them riled up they go to your home and assault your corporations with sticks and bats!

[This is version 2, version 1 won the 2012 Boston TempleCon Qualfiier, which can be found at www.thelasombra.com/decks/twd.htm#2012ctqwri]

Version 3 was played for Day 2 NAC, but couldn't beat the mighty Martin (congrats btw!). Some interesting discussion how to give it a little more forward power)
